//! Crate docs
use std::collections::HashMap;

/// A point in space.
#[derive(Debug, Clone, Copy, PartialEq)]
pub struct Point<T> {
    x: T,
    y: T,
}

impl<T: std::ops::Add<Output = T> + Copy> Point<T> {
    pub fn sum(&self) -> T {
        self.x + self.y
    }
}

fn main() {
    let mut map: HashMap<&str, i32> = HashMap::new();
    map.insert("answer", 42);
    let s = r#"raw "string""#;
    let c = 'c';
    /* block
       comment */
    for (k, v) in &map {
        println!("{k} => {v:>4} {}", s.len() as u8 + b'a');
    }
    let _ = 0x1F_u32 << 2 & !0b1010;
    macro_rules! sq { ($e:expr) => { $e * $e }; }
    let lifetime: &'static str = "<tag> & \"quote\"";
}
